record.field: Get a key at https://aistudio.google.com/apikey On the free tier, Google uses the content you send to improve its products. Use it to try Nudge with demo data, not with real customer data.
Get a key from the Groq console (console.groq.com). Set the key, then use "Fetch Models" to pick a model.

Get a key from your OpenRouter account (openrouter.ai). Set the key, then use "Fetch Models" and pick a model whose name ends with ":free". Free models are limited to 20 requests per minute and 50 per day.

Free, on a machine of yours: nothing leaves your network, no key, no bill. Install Ollama on a machine Odoo can reach (with Odoo.sh, a server of yours, not localhost), pull a model that uses tools (qwen3:4b-instruct on a laptop, qwen3:14b or larger on a server with a GPU), set its address here, press Fetch Models, choose it, Test Connection, and Prepare for Nudge when told. The guide is doc/ollama.md in the module.
Paid. Get a key from the Claude console (platform.claude.com). Requires the "anthropic" Python package on the server. Prices are in USD per million tokens.
